collection.title: Fiat Grande Panda 2024 to 2026 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Fiat Grande Panda 2024 Onwards version uses a 22" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 16" for the passengers side. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Specific Push Button type arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade available, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
